title: A refused one-call or compound focused Node Test calls the shell's exit "native" and drops the pushd frame
outcome: When a focused Node Test in the one-call form (`pushd "DIR" && …`) or a compound line is refused with a recorded exit, the summary words it as the command's exit, not the launcher's native exit, and keeps the `pushd "DIR"` frame, as engram_check_summary does.
acceptance: A refused one-call or compound focused Node Test calls the shell's exit "native" and drops the pushd frame is done
